cohort: The study included 118 mothers with Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus (T1DM) who delivered at the 1st Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology of Faculty of Medicine, Comenius University in Bratislava between January 1st, 2009, and December 31st, 2015.
finding: Mothers with T1DM and vasculopathy had significantly higher incidence rates of preeclampsia and caesarean section compared to those without microvascular complications.
mod_finding: A significantly higher incidence of caesarean section (89.1% versus 68.3%; p=0.017) was found in the vasculopathy group compared to the group without microvascular complications.
